turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who entered a zero on my son's essay before anyone picked up a phone to call me?
Don't manage me, Hale. Who entered the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Save it. What do you actually have against Owen's essay?
I really respect how much you care.
Then why are we here, Hale? If all you have is compliments, I'll be in the principal's office in fifteen minutes.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
We're not on the same team; you gave my son a zero. Show me a document with a date on it, or I'm writing down that you had nothing.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
I'm writing down that you've paid me four compliments and shown me nothing. Your own procedure 4.2 says you call the parent before any mark goes in, Hale, so start there.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn and that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a meeting with the principal; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but no evidence was ever put on the table to get there.
What moved her: Nothing, because every turn offered praise instead of something she could check.
What cost ground: Answering her procedural questions with compliments and a same-team appeal, which she read as being managed and which let her log that you had nothing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because no evidence was shown; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who entered the zero before calling home, own that mistake in one sentence and then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her.
